verdicts.cid: applying discourse semantics and pragmatics to co reference in picture sequences
verdicts.rationale: All three (2012 inproceedings, 2013 article, 2020 unpublished) share the identical title and author (Abusch). This is the Sinn und Bedeutung 17 paper; SuB 17 was held in 2012 and published in the proceedings, with a later manuscript version circulated. The year variants reflect conference-vs-proceedings-vs-manuscript dates of one and the same paper.

verdicts.cid: temporal succession and aspectual type in visual narrative
verdicts.rationale: Both entries are the same festschrift chapter: 'Temporal Succession and Aspectual Type in Visual Narrative' by Abusch, in The Art and Craft of Semantics: A Festschrift for Irene Heim, MITWPL vol 1 (no. 70), pp. 9-29. Both carry year 2014 and identical pages; the odd citekey 'abusch2002temporal' is merely a stale key. Verified via semanticsarchive and MITWPL catalog.

All three entries share the identical DOI 10.1002/9781118788516.sem003, same title ('Possible-Worlds Semantics for Pictures'), same author (Abusch), same book (Wiley Blackwell Companion to Semantics), same publisher and pages. Year 2020 vs 2021 is online-first vs formal publication date of one chapter.

verdicts.cid: arrows are the verbs of diagrams
verdicts.rationale: The two entries have byte-identical bibliographic fields: same title, authors (Alikhani & Stone), year 2018, booktitle (COLING 27th proceedings), publisher, and pages 3552-3563. Clearly the same paper.

Both entries share the identical DOI 10.18653/v1/w19-1806, same title ('Caption as a Coherence Relation'), same authors (Alikhani & Stone), same year 2019, same booktitle (Second Workshop on Shortcomings in Vision and Language), same pages 58-67. The 2017 citekey is stale; fields are identical. Same paper.

All four denote the same 1996 Oxford University Press book 'Logical Reasoning with Diagrams' by Allwein & Barwise. The DOI 10.1093/oso/9780195104271 and ISBN 0195104277 (survivor) are the same OUP volume; ISBN 9780195355864 is the EBSCO ebook edition of the same title. Survivor lacks an author field but title/publisher/year match. Verified same book via OUP Academic and booksellers.

Both are the same 1988 Cambridge University Press book 'The Cognitive Structure of Emotions'. The loser lists all three authors (Ortony, Clore, Collins) with DOI 10.1017/cbo9780511571299; the survivor lists only Ortony and year 1988 (despite the '1987' citekey) but same title/publisher. Confirmed the first edition is 1988 (ISBN 0-521-35364-5). Survivor is merely missing co-authors.

verdicts.cid: mimesis as make believe on the foundations of the representational arts
verdicts.rationale: All entries denote Kendall Walton's 'Mimesis as Make-Believe: On the Foundations of the Representational Arts', Harvard University Press. The 1990 hardcover (ISBN 9780674576032 / 0674576195) and the 1993 paperback (ISBN 9780674268227) are editions/reprints of the same book with the same content. The 'walton1990mimesisd' article entry is a garbled OCR fragment whose journal field bled in stray text, but it still points to the same Mimesis book. Same work.
